name: io.github.cyanheads/art-institute-chicago-mcp-server
description: Search the Art Institute of Chicago collection: artworks, artists, exhibitions, and audio guides.

environmentVariables.name: AIC_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: Contact the museum can reach (an email or URL, printable ASCII), sent in the AIC-User-Agent header on every request. Defaults to the repository URL; set your own for any deployment.

environmentVariables.name: AIC_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE
environmentVariables.description: Outbound request budget per minute for api.artic.edu (1-600). Defaults to 50, under the published 60 per minute anonymous limit.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
